source: /** @returns {number} */ export function immutable() { const x = 1; x = 2; return x; }
/** @param {number} n @returns {string} */ export function coercion(n) { return 'x' + n; }
/** @param {number} n @returns {number} */ export function truthy(n) { if (n) { return 1; } return 0; }
/** @param {number} n @returns {number} */ export function rounding(n) { return Math.round(n); }
/** @param {number} n @returns {boolean} */ export function loose(n) { return n == 0; }
/** @returns {number} */ export function throwing() { throw new Error('x'); }
/** @param {number} n @returns {number} */ export function defaults(n = 1) { return n; }
/** @param {boolean} yes @returns {number} */ export function missingReturn(yes) { if (yes) { return 1; } }
